claims: C1 the section provides additional context on areas where safety concerns for U18 users may be more pronounced
C2 the section adds additional requirements when necessary to reflect specific adolescent developmental needs
C3 the involvement of trusted adults is especially relevant when safety is at stake

concepts.name: additional_requirement
concepts.gloss: R is an additional requirement imposed by this section beyond the general principles

concepts.name: reflects_adolescent_developmental_needs
concepts.gloss: R reflects the specific developmental needs of adolescents

concepts.name: trusted_adult_involvement
concepts.gloss: R involves the involvement of trusted adults, especially when safety is at stake

asserts.read_back: adding requirement % is obligatory when it reflects specific adolescent developmental needs, especially the involvement of trusted adults when safety is at stake

closure.reason: The clause says the section 'adds additional requirements when necessary'; it does not state that adding requirements is generally permitted, and the context is a safety-related section where requirements are imposed, so silence about other additions is not a permission.
